# Code of conduct

Peeka follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). That text is the binding version; this is a short summary.

We want participation in this project to be harassment-free for everyone. In short:

- Be respectful and welcoming; disagree about ideas, not people.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- No harassment, insults, sexualized language or imagery, or publishing others' private information.

These rules apply in all project spaces (issues, pull requests, Discussions) and when representing the project elsewhere.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainer, [@isDionn](https://github.com/isDionn), through GitHub. For anything you would rather not post publicly, use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/isDionn/peeka/security/advisories/new) form and say it is a conduct report. All reports are handled privately. The maintainer may remove content or block contributors who break these rules, following the Covenant's enforcement guidelines.
